Package Model.Repository

Class BusinessRepository

java.lang.Object
Model.Repository.BusinessRepository
public class BusinessRepository extends Object
Repository for managing Business entities in Firestore, including creation, updates, deletions, queries and login flows.

Internally uses FirebaseFirestore for data storage, FirebaseAuth for authentication, and delegates some checks to a GeneralRepository.

    • insertBusiness

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Business> insertBusiness(String username, String password, Phone phone, String email, String businessName, Location location, String policy, Address address)
      Registers a new business user: checks username availability, creates a Firebase Authentication user, and writes the business record to Firestore.
      Parameters:
      username - desired unique username
      password - desired password
      phone - business phone number
      email - email address (used for Firebase Auth)
      businessName - display name of the business
      location - geographic location of the business
      policy - business policy text or URL
      address - physical address details of the business
      Returns:
      a Task that completes with the newly created Business object, or fails with:
      • IllegalArgumentException if username already exists;
      • any FirebaseAuth or Firestore exception otherwise.

    • checkLogin

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Business> checkLogin(String username, String password)
      Authenticates a business by username and password. First looks up the Business record to retrieve its email, then signs in via FirebaseAuth.
      Parameters:
      username - the business username
      password - the password to verify
      Returns:
      a Task that completes with the authenticated Business, or fails with:
      • NoSuchElementException if no such username;
      • SecurityException if the returned UID does not match;
      • any Firebase exception otherwise.

    • checkIfRatingExists

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Rating> checkIfRatingExists(Business business, Client client)
      Checks if the specified Client has submitted a rating for the given Business.

      This method queries the Firestore database for the business document with the given business ID. It then inspects the ratings array field within that document. Each rating entry is expected to be a map containing:

      • stars – a numeric value representing the rating score
      • comment – an optional comment string
      • client – a nested map containing the id and other client details
      If a rating associated with the given client is found, a Rating object is constructed and returned asynchronously. If no matching rating is found, the task result will be null.

      Parameters:
      business - the business for which to check ratings; if null, the task completes with null.
      client - the client whose rating should be checked; if null, the task completes with null.
      Returns:
      a Task that resolves to the matching Rating, or null if no rating exists.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the Firestore query fails and Task.getException() is null.
